📦 Tooling (Work-in-Progress)

Overview

Tooling is a Minecraft mod currently in active development that adds new blocks and tools to expand building and crafting possibilities. Right now, the mod introduces one new block, with more blocks and tools planned for future updates.

🧱 Current Features

Glowbrick — A glowing version of the brick, perfect for building houses without torches or adding a luminous touch to your creations.

🔨 Upcoming Features (Planned)

More decorative and functional blocks

New tool tiers with unique abilities

Expanded crafting recipes and gameplay progression

⚙️ Why Try This Early Version

Get a first look at the mod while it’s being actively developed

Provide feedback to shape future blocks and tools

Experiment with new building materials before the full release
